name: Steady
text: Every stat holds a floor of three.

name: Bloodhound
text: Add two on the last check of every stage.

name: Unkillable
text: Once a quest you survive the blow that would kill you.

name: Ironlung
text: You carry two more Strain before you fall.

name: Quickstudy
text: Add one on any stat you have not rolled yet this quest.

name: Surehanded
text: A natural one is rolled again, on every stat.

name: Bulwark
text: Two more Armor to soak the hurt before it lands.

name: Grim
text: After an ally dies, add two on every check this quest.

name: Ninth Hour
text: Add three on every check at the boss.

name: Untethered
text: Ambush never falls on you.

name: Deepdrawn
text: Your highest stat surges one face sooner.

name: Steadfast
text: Contagion from an ally who fails NERVE never reaches you.

name: Tollworn
text: The Toll takes no Strain from you on the way in.

name: Chainborn
text: Hand over hand down a Chain, you add two on every check.

name: Handfast
text: Add two on a Relay check, your hand in an ally's.

name: Keyfinger
text: Add two on a Vault, whatever stat you bring to the lock.

name: Firstfoot
text: First into the dark, and the stage's opening check adds two.

name: Slickstep
text: GRACE never reads below half its die.

name: Two Hearts
text: Your first NERVE check each stage beats twice and the higher stands.

name: Stonewrist
text: Where the door is heaviest, your MIGHT adds three.

name: Coldbreath
text: When you bench, the most strained ally clears one as well.

name: Twicetold
text: One WITS check each stage reads the dark twice, keeping the higher.

name: Breakwater
text: You take one less from every Aspect that strikes you.

name: Quietsleep
text: You sleep like the drowned, so a bench clears one more Strain.
